group.name: Paramilitary (CAPF & Assam Rifles) Direct Recruitments
group.intro: These are specialist posts each force recruits itself; general-duty posts come through SSC GD, SSC CPO and UPSC CAPF AC. Each specialist post has its own notice, and the posts are not interchangeable. The details below are typical of recent notices. Fee is usually ₹100 for UR/OBC/EWS men and nil for women, SC, ST and ex-servicemen. Most have no interview; Medical Officer posts are interview-based. Common constable-level PST: men 170 cm, women 157 cm (UR); ST 162.5 / 150 cm; chest 80 + 5 cm for men. For CAPF constable posts, MHA has announced reservation and PET exemption for ex-Agniveers; check each notice for the exact conditions.

rows.rule: CAPF and Railway: up to 5 years for the first batch, 3 years after

notes: Final-year students can usually apply for graduate exams if they will have the degree by the cut-off date in the notice.
CAPF direct recruitments follow central relaxation: OBC +3, SC / ST +5. Ex-servicemen: age minus service + 3 years. Ex-Agniveers: as per the MHA rules in each notice.
PwBD candidates are not eligible for combat and uniformed CAPF posts.
NSG and SPG take personnel on deputation only, so there is no direct age or qualification rule.
Departmental candidates in the same force usually get extra relaxation; check the notice.
